attributes.residual: TWO ITEM CURES REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT AND NOT EXECUTED. Item 4 asked to route webfrank rule text to stderr or add --quiet: both LOSE the text exactly when it is wanted, and unittest's own `-b` buffers per-test output and REPLAYS it under a `Stdout:` header for failing tests only — verified both ways with a constructed pass/fail pair, so the deliverable is the documented flag, not a code change (it also keeps the lane out of webfrank.py, which WC owns this run). Item 8 asked to revert webfrank.json alongside the source: rejected, because that file is global state shared with every concurrent lane and a rule change needs configure.py re-run before its build edge exists (trap 6) — the tool now NAMES this unit's rule drift before the build is spent instead. ITEM 6 SHIPPED ADVISORY, NOT BLOCKING, ON MEASUREMENT: 92 anchored corpus records fire the slot/frame trigger and 40 (43%) quote no arbiter, 16 of 58 (28%) since 2026-09-01.
